fixture_identity.remote: ScriptedRemote — no GitHub network in path

inclusion_criteria: bounded scope: a single PR-addressable issue, no cross-repo work
no secrets, personal data or production-credential handling in scope
acceptance criteria writable as a checklist
size class S or M — comparable to a direct-IDD fix

explanation: worker-log detail (attempt liveness heartbeats) is deleted after 7 days
detailed audit metadata (event detail, usage payloads, check artifacts, preview/control detail) is pruned 30 days after work reaches a terminal state — active and parked work is never pruned

identity tombstones persist until explicit registration removal: work logical identity, delivery dedup records, control/command identities, publication/merge intent identities and the notification outbox stay, so an old webhook delivery still collides with dedup instead of recreating work
export copies the retained history; delete removes the repo-scoped detail rows — neither drops tombstones while the registration stands; only the reviewed registration removal does
